purpose: Review a finite Campaign142 catalog against the complete 153-definition frontier and accepted local point-in-time source schemas before reading any source row, candidate value, comparator value, daily price, forward return, or 2024-2025 stress value.

accepted_local_schema_audit.inspection_method: filesystem inventory, immutable JSON metadata, and pyarrow Parquet schema only; no row group or column value opened

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: quarterly_realized_net_profit_sign_transition_2q
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: classify a latest effective net_profit transition from nonpositive to positive across adjacent report periods
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: one exact prior report period and zero sign threshold
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Net-profit scale, quality-profit state, growth, acceleration, rank gaps and transition operators are terminal. Adding a zero threshold and adjacent-quarter state does not reveal a new source state; it is a post-exposure discretization of an exposed accounting field and introduces a cold-start predecessor requirement.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: income_cashflow_statement_disclosure_gap_days
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: negative absolute calendar-day gap between income_actual_announcement_date and cashflow_actual_announcement_date for one report period
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The accepted cash-conversion sample exposes both dates, but both full-history acquisition attempts are terminal source failures. A small acceptance sample is not an accepted 2019-2023 point-in-time research source and cannot be promoted by silently reading or extrapolating it.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: sw_l1_membership_entry_or_exit_recency
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: accepted-session age since an SW2021 L1 interval in_date or until out_date
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The membership snapshot supports point-in-time peer assignment, not proof of when a historical rebalance announcement became public. Campaign127 already rejected index membership change at this exact clock gate; effective dates alone cannot support a three-day announcement signal.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: insider_transaction_actual_reporting_delay
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: negative sessions from the latest direct-market transaction to its actual public filing
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The accepted source has transaction dates and a conservative synthetic third-session availability date, not the actual historical filing timestamp. Treating that synthetic clock as measured reporting delay would invent source semantics, while changing it would reopen a terminal insider branch.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: sparse_corporate_event_peer_crowding_sparsity
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: one divided by the number of issuers disclosing the same event family on the same date
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: repurchase, unlock, pledge, survey or analyst family selected after prior results
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Quarterly peer-crowding sparsity is already terminal, and each proposed event family has terminal value, freshness, capacity or return evidence. Moving the same crowding operator across those exposed sparse families requires post-result family selection and cannot create missing event cohorts.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_range_width_serial_persistence_238p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: population correlation of adjacent log(high/low) widths within the two fixed half sessions
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.filters: exact 240 finite ordered high-low bars and positive variance
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Absolute-return serial persistence, body-magnitude serial persistence, range weak-order states, range local peaks, range clock moments and multiple volatility-resolution mechanisms already cover the same latent volatility-clustering state. Swapping the width proxy and correlation functional is an alternate statistic, not a new information mechanism.

selection.reason: No concept simultaneously has an accepted full historical point-in-time source, an identifiable public availability clock, and semantic independence from the 153 terminal definitions.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Continue only from a genuinely new finite mechanism supported by an already accepted historically versioned point-in-time source, or obtain explicit authorization for a separately frozen source-admission campaign.
